_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#1 (u.Other() is the only neighbour accessor; the miss names ProxyFunction, not 'trial function'). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, L2 order 1 dgjumps=True: type(u) really is ngsolve.comp.ProxyFunction, u.neighbour raises AttributeError whose text contains the class name and "has no attribute 'neighbour'", and the phrase the claim says is never emitted ('trial function has no attribute neighbour') is indeed absent from it. None of neighbour/neighbor/Neighbour/Neighbor/other exists on the object; Other does. A form built from 0.5*(u+u.Other()) over dx(skeleton=True) assembles to 756 non-zeros against 216 for the element-local mass matrix on the plain L2 space, so Other() genuinely couples across facets. Mutation: replacing u.neighbour by u.Other in the probe removes the AttributeError and the fixture fails on neighbour_raises_attributeerror. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 points the attribute probe at 'Other' instead of 'neighbour' (constant PROBE, read via getattr(u, PROBE)), so the lookup succeeds. Re-verified by execution 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: the unmutated run matches all 8 expect_in_output strings; T2_MUTATE=1 removes 'neighbour_raises_attributeerror=True', 'msg_names_proxyfunction=True' and 'msg_says_no_attribute_neighbour=True' so the fixture goes red. CAVEAT measured 2026-08-06: 'Other_reaches_across_facets' compares mat.nze on the dgjumps space against the plain space, but nze is a property of the space alone -- u*v*dx(skeleton=True) with no Other() anywhere in it also assembles to 756 nze on this mesh -- so that line does not select for Other(); counting entries that actually received a value, as dg_facet_term_over_plain_dx_rejected does, would. Re-run: T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py FIXED 2026-08-08 (assertion changed): Other_reaches_across_facets was nze(mean form on L2(order=1, dgjumps=True)) > nze(mass form on L2(order=1)), i.e. 756 > 216 -- and dgjumps=True is exactly the flag that asks NGSolve for the wider sparsity PATTERN. The inequality measured the ALLOCATION the flag requests, not Other(). Measured 2026-08-08 on NGSolve 6.2.2604: an element-local u*v*dx form on the same dgjumps=True space also has nze=756, so the old comparison came out True for a form with no Other() anywhere in it. The control is now the SAME space and the SAME skeleton integral with Other() as the only difference, and what is counted is not the allocated pattern but the stored entries that are non-zero AND connect DOFs owned by two different elements. Measured: mean_form_nze=756, no_Other_form_nze=756 (identical allocation, asserted as both_forms_share_the_same_allocation=True so the comparison stays honest), mean_form_cross_element_entries=444 with peak value 1.178511e-01, no_Other_form_cross_element_entries=0. CONTROL, executed: rebuild the mean form WITHOUT Other() -- nze stays 756, so the old assertion would still have printed True, while the new one goes to cross_entries=0 and Other_reaches_across_facets=False with rc=2. T2_MUTATE=1 still turns the fixture red on the three neighbour-spelling expectations.
